title: senecio flaccidus var. durangensis
intro: Senecio flaccidus var. durangensis, commonly known as Lamb's Quarters or also referred to as Gravel Ghost or even as Gravel Ghost Senecio, is a plant species within the daisy or sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Senecio flaccidus var. durangensis include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are known for their therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
